open_findings.finding: Reused disjoint TLSF initialization bookkeeping storage and bounded counter widths, saving 16 bytes without shrinking pools. Heap and compact simulator factory builds pass; adapter regressions pass.

RF UART FIFO now reserves existing capacity for independent canonical control/ACK frames and permits bounded bypass without reordering SDT frames. Native sanitizer regressions and heap/compact firmware builds pass. Linked RF ACK timing improved; gateway ACK loss remains.

LTC2990 model lost HAL RELOAD split writes; GPIO AF read used ODR rather than external pad. Corrected both and added regressions. Valve fixture now includes both monitors and SDA/SCL pullups. Linked continuity qualification still pending.

Actual I2C v1 and SPI stage_response used try_pop_latest, silently discarding distinct queued ACKs. Changed to FIFO, removed lossy staging API, added simulator distinct-ACK regression and rebuilt paired Pico firmware. Bounded overwrite-on-full policy remains; linked queue-eviction tracing ongoing.

Host radio airtime used wall-clock deadlines while firmware UART/modem ran in virtual time. Added virtual-only deadline pacing when an explicit simulator clock is configured; ordinary operation/HITL without that clock keeps Instant. Validation must measure each round transmission/ACK, not wait for unrelated schema/telemetry TX queues to become empty.

Detailed traces show priority-255 address/topology advertisements fill both the command allowance and its FIFO. Separate canonical route scheduling and exclude discovery/SDT from the application-control reserve while retaining accepted frames and alternating metadata turns. Regression passes; linked check pending.

Gateway simulator receive-result capture proves FLIGHT_STATE is rejected by memory admission (four early refusals). Registered managed values with schema priority 16 also entered threaded RX at 16 rather than service priority 254. Preserve service priority and bounded protected admission without shrinking working estimates; regression reproduces old refusal and passes heap/compact. All seven candidate firmware builds pass; repeat linked check pending.

Native regression reproduces a queued radio ACK redirected by a CAN echo. Router and Relay now preserve original live ingress within the retry window; expiry and disabled-side tests retain alternate-path recovery. No additional retained state. First linked I2C/TCP checks of the initial guard pass; bounded-window refinement is undergoing rebuild/repetition.

RF ISR ring allocated one 256-byte slot per short IDLE fragment; a native sanitizer regression reproduces exhaustion after four 13-byte fragments. Replace it with the same 1024-byte capacity stored as a byte ring, saving slot lengths. Enable USART1 hardware FIFO and add RX error/drop probes. Correct G4 simulator FIFO from 16 to eight bytes using the bundled HAL depth definitions; add UART model capacity/overrun regression. Linked repetition still required.

Renode return-register trace proves valid managed frames return SEDS_IO under pressure. RF still used legacy two-argument admission, so registered protected controls could not use control headroom. Wire RF to extended work classes; retain full estimates and contiguous floor, use exact constant-time TLSF free accounting and a private fallback trial. Actual allocator regressions materialize the full work and verify 4 KiB general reserve, protected exhaustion and recovery.

Read-only simulator captures show gateway UART hardware errors and RF normal-DMA receive gaps. Switch RF USART1 and both gateways USART2 to circular ReceiveToIdle with HT/TC/IDLE delta accounting; retain current DMA buffers and queues. Native tests cover partial positions, wraparound, duplicate callbacks, invalid positions and restart generation.

Long I2C capture logs 32 mailbox evictions including SDT templates, then valve battery stale gaps. Eight inline 4 KiB slots exhausted count long before byte capacity. Replace storage with an 8 KiB byte ring and 128 I2C packet descriptors, saving about 47 KiB across I2C queues. Network replies use non-evicting admission and readers pause while still servicing host-to-network requests. Apply to SPI replies too. Native burst, wrapping, ownership and wakeup tests plus paired builds pass; linked requalification pending.

operator_procedure_requirements.hitl: Keep existing HITL behavior unchanged for complete testing.
operator_procedure_requirements.test_fire: No AV bay is present at test-fire site; never require FC/RF/PB or rocket GPS there.
operator_procedure_requirements.startup: All fill valves closed except dump and vent.
operator_procedure_requirements.qualification: Self-test then nitrogen test, then main fill to configured set point, then launch eligibility. Completed prerequisites survive board power cycles and service restarts until explicit UI reset.
operator_procedure_requirements.connectivity: All fill-system boards must be connected with stable topology before sequences. Warn on unstable connectivity; dropping boards outside idle before Launch triggers abort.
operator_procedure_requirements.valve_safety: Correct valve misconfiguration. Nitrogen opening during nitrous fill or other unsafe cross-flow must immediately latch a fault and request abort before Launch.
operator_procedure_requirements.abort_boundary: Automatic GroundStation aborts cease on entry to FlightState::Launch, including countdown. Do not change independent FC recovery/watchdog or assume manual emergency controls should be removed.
operator_procedure_requirements.flight_launch: Notify FC of impending launch and require valid command/return routes plus fresh rocket GPS lock. These requirements do not apply to test-fire.
operator_procedure_requirements.quick_disconnect: In regular launch mode, require a fresh QD command acknowledgement and wait five seconds FROM ACK before launch. A launch request during QD wait queues once, blinks T-clock and notifies remaining delay. Recheck live gates before releasing the queued launch.
open_details: Exact launch/test-fire valve and ignition action order/timings beyond existing sequence; preserve existing output timing until confirmed.
operator_procedure_requirements.nitrogen_test: All valves closed except Nitrogen, which is stepped slowly with a closed-valve pressure-settling period between steps.
operator_procedure_requirements.restart_outputs: A saved filled tank is held closed on service restart. Empty checkout requests dump/vent open only with fresh empty-tank pressure, stable routes and the operating interlock; restarting never replays a launch request.
